Dear Mr. Herried:
This is to acknowledge receipt of a letter dated June 19, 1973, from Mr. H. L. Fiedler, State Highway Engineer, transmitting a copy of a draft environmental statement for the Airport pur, from IH-94 to General Mitchell Field, for comment from the Southeastern Wisconsin Regional Planning Commission and for the purpose of making the draft statement available for public inspection and copying at the Commission offices. It is the purpose of this letter to provide the comments resulting from the Commission's staff review of the statement and to indicate that the Commission did not receive any requests for public inspection or information on the document.
The following comments are based upon the Commission's staff review.
1. The statement concisely sets forth the history of the Airport Spur, describing the planning efforts and decisions, agency actions and approvals, and the importance of adequate ground transportation links to the air transportation system. The Regional Planning Commission has recognized General Mitchell Field as a major transportation facility and as a concentration of employment activity in its areawide, comprehensive land use and transportation planning processes. The freeway spur itself was considered within the jurisdictional highway system planning process for Milwaukee County and approved as a refinement to the adopted regional transportation plan.
